versions.content: Compatibility of ApplicationCompositeElementDat- aPrototype typed by primitive data type of category BOOLEAN in a PPort- Prototype and a SystemSignal to which the ApplicationCompositeEle- mentDataPrototype is mapped by SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping If a VariableDataPrototype in a PPortPrototype typed by Application- CompositeDataType is mapped by a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping to a SystemSignalGroup then the following conditions shall be fulfilled by an Ap- plicationCompositeElementDataPrototype that is aggregated by the Appli- cationCompositeDataType and the SystemSignal of the SystemSignalGroup to which the ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype is mapped in case that the ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype is typed by an Appli- cationPrimitiveDataType of category BOOLEAN: • the dataConstr s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Ap- plicationDataType of the VariableDataPrototype are compatible to the dataConstr s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [con- str_9373]. • the compuMethod s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on ApplicationDataType of the VariableDataPrototype is compatible to the compuMethod of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [con- str_9372].
